sim.quest.accepted: You took on a job for {village_name}.
sim.village.recruited: {unit_name}, a {race} {role} from {village_name}, joins you for {gold} gold.
quest.blocked.gone: That job is no longer available.
quest.blocked.hostile: They will not deal with you while you are at war.
quest.blocked.too_many: You are already juggling too many jobs.
quest.blocked.presence: Send someone there to speak with them.
quest.blocked.unfinished: The job is not finished yet.
village.recruit.unknown: You do not know that place yet.
village.recruit.ruined: There is nobody left to ask.
village.recruit.relation: They only let their own leave for friends.
village.recruit.population: They cannot spare another pair of hands.
village.recruit.cooldown: They let someone go recently. Come back in a day or two.
village.recruit.beds: No free bed at home — build more housing first.
village.recruit.presence: Send someone there to make the offer.
village.recruit.gold: Not enough gold for the parting gift.
village.talk.generic.1: Mind the ruts on the road, traveller.
village.talk.generic.2: Quiet season. Long may it last.
village.talk.generic.3: We get by. That is more than most.
village.talk.wary.1: Say your piece and move along.
village.talk.wary.2: Strangers bring weather, my mother said.
village.talk.neutral.1: You are welcome to look around, {unit_name} is my name.
village.talk.friendly.1: Good to see you again. The kettle is on.
village.talk.allied.1: Our roof is your roof. You know that by now.
village.talk.farmer.1: The far field is drying out. We could use rain, not visitors.
village.talk.farmer.2: Two more harvests like this and we eat well in winter.
village.talk.crafter.1: Good timber is getting hard to come by.
village.talk.crafter.2: Give me a day at the bench and I will make it right.
village.talk.trader.1: Everything at the stall has a price, friend.
village.talk.trader.2: Caravans have been thin this season.
village.talk.guard.1: I walk this ring from dawn till dusk. Nothing gets past.
village.talk.guard.2: Keep your blade sheathed inside the fence.
village.talk.elder.1: I have seen companies like yours come and go, {unit_name}.
village.talk.elder.2: {village_name} was here before the machines. It will be here after.
village.talk.rumor_site.1: There is something out {direction} of here — {site_name}. I marked it for you.
village.talk.rumor_site.2: A hunter came back talking about {site_name}, {direction} of the village.
village.talk.rumor_want.1: If you are carrying {resource}, we would pay well for it.
village.talk.race.human: We build where the water runs and hope it stays.
village.talk.race.sylvan: Walk softly. The old trees are listening.
village.talk.race.stoutkin: Stone remembers longer than any of us.
village.talk.race.vulpin: Everything is a trade, even a conversation.
village.talk.race.minotaur: We do not boast. We simply do not lose.
village.talk.race.centaur: The grass runs to the horizon. So do we.
village.talk.race.harpy: You look heavy, walking everywhere like that.
village.talk.race.lamia: The river brings what it brings. We take our share.
village.talk.race.oni: Drink if you are offered a cup. Refusing is the insult.
village.talk.race.tengu: From up on the ridge your whole road is one line.
village.talk.race.goblin: Shiny things lying about? Finders keepers, that is the law.
village.talk.race.orc: Strength is respect. Show us yours and we will talk.
village.talk.race.kobold: Tunnels are warm and the dark is honest. Up here it is too bright.
village.talk.race.lizardfolk: The marsh feeds the patient. Hurry and it swallows you.
village.talk.race.gnome: Every gear has a purpose. Even the squeaky ones — especially those.
village.talk.race.halfling: Second breakfast is at ten. You are welcome to stay for it.
